text:
Priya: Hey @Jordan — welcome aboard! Dropping a compact manager-first-week checklist so you can triage setup vs people work. Reply with any blockers.

Jordan: Thanks! Super helpful. Can you paste the quick 30/60/90 bullet list? Also who approves infra access?

Priya: Approvals: infra access = Security + your manager. Quick 30/60/90 bullets: 
- 30d: meet direct reports, ship one small process improvement, finish RW product overview
- 60d: own a triage rotation, run first retro, draft team goals aligned to product OKRs
- 90d: deliver plan for quarterly priorities + success metrics and stakeholder map
Keep items measurable (metrics, owners, due dates).

Jordan: Nice. Can you add the week 1 agenda?

Priya: Week 1 plan: 
- Day 0: HR paperwork, Duo enroll, laptop + corp SSO validated
- Day 1: Team intro (30m), 1:1s scheduled, codebase tour (45m)
- Day 2: Shadow on-call, review runbooks, access requests submitted
- Day 3: Stakeholder intros (PM, Eng-sre), fill 30/60/90 draft
- Day 4: Prioritize first 30d deliverables, schedule weekly sync cadence

Maria (IT): FYI command to request assets: 
```
/it-request --asset laptop --model m3 --user jordan
```
Include shipping address + phone for MFA.

Kevin (Security): Must finish Security 101 + sign Access Agreement before we grant prod-write roles. Quick tip: request least privilege first, then escalate if needed.

Sam: I'll DM a starter list of 1:1 topics and a template for one-month OKRs. Also setting recurring 30m 1:1s on your calendar.

Jordan: Who should I copy on escalations if hardware or access stalls?

Priya: Ping @Maria for hardware, @Kevin for security, and me if it's blocking ramp. We'll triage in the ops standup.

onboarding-bot: Created manager welcome folder and linked templates: https://drive.redwood.ai/onboarding/manager-kit

Jordan: Filing IT request + starting trainings now. Will post when laptop arrives and 1:1s scheduled. Thanks all! :rocket:
filetype_note: Slack thread: messages are a single continuous string; messages prefixed with sender names per agents.md
